issue.title: [A+] Dependabot one-at-a-time + doctor checklist
issue.body:
## Summary / context

Part of **A+ Process / CI**. Dependabot discipline (one PR at a time, `doctor` after npm bumps) is documented but easy to skip under load.

## Current vs expected

**Current:** `.cursor/rules/dependabot-workflow.mdc` + guides exist.

**Expected:** Short checklist issue/template or addition to `docs/guides/dependabot-process.md` used for the next 4 bumps; no code change required unless docs are missing a step.

## Scope

**In scope**
- Doc checklist (merge order, doctor, rebase others, expo install --fix when needed)
- Optional: link from `.github/dependabot.yml` comment / README

**Out of scope**
- Auto-merge Dependabot without human/agent process
- Large version upgrades

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Checklist exists in-repo
- [ ] Linked from dependabot guide
- [ ] Engineering/docs only

## Verification / test plan

1. Docs review only
2. Apply on next Dependabot PR and note on this issue

## Links

- `docs/guides/dependabot-process.md`, `.cursor/rules/dependabot-workflow.mdc`
